payload.title: Repair and package the existing publisher safely
payload.goal: Retain reusable Buffer behavior while fixing the packaged startup, bootstrap and account-selection gaps.
payload.owner_role: Windows combined release parent / admitted WHB lane
implementation_steps: Recover qualified BOTS-29 fix where available; otherwise materialize archive source as whb_operator.py without the stdlib operator collision and deterministically rebuild the ZIP with path safety/checksum verification.

Replace first-organization/first-service choice with exact expected organization/channel IDs and explicit enabled platform set, initially X only; unsupported/ambiguous identities fail closed. Retain media checking, queue caps and stop controls as reusable code.

Make manual dry-run the bootstrap mode, publish disabled until a verified capability/review grant is recorded, keep dry-run state isolated with simulated classification, and serialize workflow edits with release parent. No schedule/secret changes in this planning task.
tests: Python 3.12 packaged no-key smoke test emits WAIT_HOW_BIG_NOT_CONFIGURED, never circular import; deterministically rebuilt archive hash is reproducible.
Dry-run makes zero createPost calls and cannot create scheduled/public receipts in production state.
Multiple organizations/same-service channels/wrong account/disabled platform and newly installed secret with no grant all block writes.

review.identity_requirement: A reviewer other than the implementer records actual identity, model/effort and host; distinct-model review when required by the admitted contract. Self-review does not qualify.
review.source_binding: Review exact Git commit and SHA256 manifest of changed source/assets/config; distinguish Windows CRLF worktree bytes from Git blobs. Any repair invalidates affected prior approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two repair/review attempts per candidate within admitted budget; unresolved failure creates one actionable block and leaves independent work eligible.

acceptance: Existing publisher starts safely and exact-account X-only dry-run can be qualified.
Scheduled publishing cannot begin simply because a usable credential appears.
payload.rollback: Disable this capability, retain immutable evidence/receipts, restore the last reviewed source/config version and reconcile attempted external effects before any retry.
payload.next_eligible_action: Designated owner matches the proposed scope to current Jira/source and assigns disjoint paths; then perform implementation step 1. External gates block only the named effects.

estimate.assumptions: New planning estimate, not historical estimate or worklog. Reuse accepted returned implementation where its exact source passes this contract. Excludes elapsed observation windows, account waiting and shared SH implementation.
estimate.dependency_risk: Host/provider/account qualification or conflicting release-worker ownership can delay dependent effects; offline work remains eligible.
